title: Easy to Clean, but Copper Coating Scrapes off Easily
text: Easy to Clean, but Copper Coating Scrapes off Easily. I wanted a 9x13 pan that was both easy to clean and had a lid. The lid on this is easy to remove and nice and sturdy. The first thing I made in this was a pan of Special K Bars/Scotcharoos and when I went to remove them they just came right out! There was nothing stuck to the pan! For that reason, it was SUPER easy to clean. Yay! But my issue with it was that the top copper coating started coming off in places where I cut the bars. I wasn't even using a sharp knife, just a plain butter knife. I guess I will just have to not use any utensils that may scratch the bottom.

description: Equally perfect for a batch of Horchata Brownies or some Roasted Pear and Cranberry Brussels Sprouts, this Ayesha Bakeware 9-Inch x 13-Inch Cake Pan features a bonus plastic lid with a snug fit for keeping baked goods and roasted foods fresh. Plus, the pan (not the lid!) is oven safe to 450°F, so you can take advantage of its textured diamond pattern to promote even browning. Novice bakers and seasoned pros alike will love the high-performance steel construction with extended edges that make for super-easy handling in and out of the oven. The cake pan lid helps keep cakes, cookies and bake goods countertop fresh for storing leftovers until they're all gone. Dishwasher safe for easy clean-up (hand wash recommended to prolong product life), the Ayesha Bakeware 9-inch x 13-inch cake pan is essential bakeware for everyday goodies and special gourmet meals alike.
